en-US.description: Agent harness for SJTU students with campus services, an AI coding agent, and workspace tools.
en-US.longDescription: Dela is an agent harness designed for SJTU students. Its agent kernel is built on Pi, and campus services interact with the university through public SJTU APIs. It integrates Canvas courseware preview with batch download, campus email, lecture video playback with speech-recognition transcripts, a course schedule calendar with TODO integration, a community reader, and global search. The built-in agent supports third-party skills, MCP servers, and custom web search, with particular strength in coding, and remote projects connect a far server over SSH so agent reads, writes, and commands run directly on the server. A workspace adds Markdown note editing, plain-text file editing, and an integrated terminal. Credentials are encrypted in the system keyring and other data stays on the local machine.

zh-CN.author: Zhixi Hu
zh-CN.description: 为上海交通大学学生打造的智能体套件，集成校园信息服务、AI 编程助手与工作台工具。
zh-CN.longDescription: Dela 是一款专门面向 SJTUer 的 Agent 产品，内核基于 Pi 构建，所有校园服务功能都通过交大公开 API 和学校服务器交互。集成 Canvas 课程资料快捷预览与批量下载、校园邮箱、课堂视频回看（语音识别文稿跳转与导出）、课表日历与 TODO 双向互通、水源社区阅读、全局搜索等校园信息服务。内置 Agent 支持导入第三方 skills 与接入 MCPs，提供自定义 web_search 与免费 web_fetch 工具，在 Coding 领域特别加强；remote project 通过 SSH 把远端服务器目录登记为项目，Agent 的读写与命令直接在服务器上执行。工作台提供 Markdown 笔记编辑、任意文本文件编辑与内置终端。凭据经系统钥匙串加密后保存在本机，其余数据保存在本地，不上传服务器。
